overview.title: What is Próspera?
overview.text: Próspera is a special economic zone on Roatán, Honduras, where founders build businesses under a streamlined legal framework with a 1% effective tax rate.

overview.title: Who joins Próspera?
overview.text: Próspera attracts entrepreneurs, remote workers, investors, biotech founders, and crypto builders from over 40 countries. The community includes over 1,700 residents and 200+ active businesses, anchored by a growing hub around longevity research and decentralized finance.

history.text:
Próspera was founded by Venezuelan entrepreneur Erick Brimen after Honduras amended its constitution in 2013 to allow Zones for Employment and Economic Development (ZEDEs). Brimen learned about the ZEDE law in 2016, spent two years working with Honduran authorities to secure land and draft a governance charter, and launched Próspera publicly on Roatán island in 2020.

The zone began on 58 acres in St. John's Bay, Roatán, with construction of its first buildings starting in 2021. Despite the Honduran government's 2022 repeal of the ZEDE law under President Xiomara Castro, Próspera's operations are protected by a 50-year legal stability agreement under the ZEDE Organic Law and a bilateral investment treaty with Kuwait.

By late 2024, Próspera had incorporated 250+ companies, received a Deloitte legal opinion confirming operational continuity, and reduced e-residency fees from $1,300 to $130 per year. In January 2025, Coinbase's venture arm joined as a backer, and the Infinita City popup event drew 400+ attendees to the zone.

location:
Próspera is located on the Caribbean island of Roatán, Honduras, in the St. John's Bay area roughly 20 minutes from Roatán International Airport (RTB). Direct flights connect Roatán to Miami, Houston, Atlanta, Denver, Toronto, and Madrid.

The zone spans over 1,000 acres and includes [Duna Residences](https://www.dunaresidences.com/) - the tallest residential building on Roatán - along with coworking spaces, lab facilities, restaurants, and event venues. Budget accommodation is available at the [Beta Residencies](https://www.infinita.city/visit) hostel, and luxury stays at [Las Verandas](https://www.lasverandasroatan.com/) hotel and villas are a short distance away. The Mesoamerican Barrier Reef, the world's second-largest coral reef system, runs just offshore.
duration:
Próspera offers three access tiers suited to different stay lengths. The Visitor Pass allows unlimited daily access and up to 30 overnight stays per year. e-Residency is designed for people spending up to 30 days per calendar year while retaining full business registration and property ownership rights. Full Residency supports year-round living with 365-day access.

For a short exploratory visit, [Próspera Weekend](https://luma.com/Prospera-events) events run Thursday through Saturday roughly once per month, providing a structured three-day introduction. Longer programs like [Infinita City](https://www.infinita.city/) run multi-week and multi-month cohorts focused on biotech and longevity.
pricing:
The [Próspera Weekend](https://luma.com/Prospera-events) costs $450 per person and includes lodging at [Las Verandas](https://www.lasverandasroatan.com/) or [Beta Hostel](https://www.infinita.city/visit), all meals, event transport, business formation workshops, and a snorkeling excursion on the Mesoamerican Reef. Upcoming dates: May 22-24 and June 26-28, 2026.

Business entity formation starts from $280, with annual operating fees of $279 per year. The effective business income tax rate is 1% (10% applied to 10% of gross income). Personal income tax is 5% effective. Capital gains, payroll, and import duties are eliminated.

e-Residency is $130 per year and Full Residency is $130 per year plus mandatory insurance (rate determined by risk scoring). The Visitor Pass is free. A lump-sum tax residency option is available at $5,000 per year and covers all income taxes regardless of earnings.

howToEnter.text:
Apply online at [portal.eprospera.com](https://portal.eprospera.com/en). Select a residency tier - the Visitor Pass is free, e-Residency and Full Residency are both $130/year - then review the Agreement of Coexistence, pay the annual fee, submit your personal information with proof of identity, and complete a government ID scan and selfie. Approvals typically take 1-3 business days. Applicants from a small list of restricted countries require additional exemptions.

To explore before applying, attend a [Próspera Weekend](https://luma.com/Prospera-events) ($450, housing and meals included) or join the free weekly onboarding call every Wednesday at 5:00 PM UTC via Zoom.

faqs.question: What is Próspera and how does it work?
faqs.answer: Próspera is a special economic zone (ZEDE) on Roatán island, Honduras, operated by Próspera Inc. under a 50-year legal stability agreement. It runs its own legal framework, tax system, and e-governance platform, allowing residents and businesses to operate under rules distinct from Honduras national law. Over 200 businesses and 1,700 residents from 40+ countries currently participate.

faqs.question: Where is Próspera located?
faqs.answer: Próspera is in St. John's Bay on Roatán island, Honduras - about 20 minutes from Roatán International Airport (RTB). Direct flights connect Roatán to Miami, Houston, Atlanta, Denver, Toronto, and Madrid. Flying via San Pedro Sula (SPS) first is often cheaper if coming from Central America.

faqs.question: What are the tax rates in Próspera?
faqs.answer: The effective business income tax is 1% (10% on 10% of gross income). Personal income tax is 5% effective. Sales tax is 2.5% effective. Capital gains, inheritance, payroll, and import duties are eliminated. Bitcoin is an official unit of account, so you can pay taxes and denominate contracts in BTC.

faqs.question: What residency options does Próspera offer?
faqs.answer: Three tiers are available: Visitor Pass (free, up to 30 overnight stays per year), e-Residency ($130/year, up to 30 days/year with full business rights), and Full Residency ($130/year plus insurance, year-round access). A lump-sum tax residency option at $5,000/year covers all income taxes regardless of income. [Apply at portal.eprospera.com](https://portal.eprospera.com/en).

faqs.question: Is Próspera legally secure given Honduras' repeal of the ZEDE law?
faqs.answer: Próspera holds a 50-year legal stability guarantee under Article 45 of the ZEDE Organic Law and Honduras's bilateral investment treaty with Kuwait. The three existing ZEDEs were grandfathered when Honduras repealed the enabling law in 2022. In December 2024, Deloitte issued a legal opinion confirming operational continuity. An active ICSID arbitration claim provides further backstop.

faqs.question: What is the Próspera Weekend?
faqs.answer: Próspera Weekend is a three-day immersive event held roughly monthly, priced at $450 and including housing, all meals, event transport, and workshops on business formation, investment, and residency. Attendees also get a snorkeling trip on the Mesoamerican Reef and private dinners with Próspera leadership. Upcoming dates: May 22-24 and June 26-28, 2026. [See the calendar](https://luma.com/Prospera-events).

faqs.question: What industries are active in Próspera?
faqs.answer: Technology, biotech, longevity research, crypto/blockchain, and decentralized finance are the most active sectors. Próspera operates a BioHub accelerator and explicitly supports regulatory sandboxes for drug commercialization and gene therapy. Monthly events rotate through biotech, crypto, and governance topics. Over 950 active jobs are tied to zone operations.

faqs.question: How do I start a business in Próspera?
faqs.answer: Register as a resident at [portal.eprospera.com](https://portal.eprospera.com/en), complete an entity application, sign documents, and you can start hiring, fundraising, and doing business. Entity formation starts from $280 with $279/year in annual fees. Registration completes online in under 24 hours, and the entity is globally recognized. You can also choose from multiple regulatory frameworks or propose your own.

faqs.question: What housing options are available in Próspera?
faqs.answer: Options span budget to luxury. [Beta Residencies](https://www.infinita.city/visit) hostel is the most affordable on-site option. [Duna Residences](https://www.dunaresidences.com/), the tallest building on Roatán, offers mid-range apartments currently at 100% occupancy as of early 2025 (contact realestate@pristinebay.hn for availability). [Las Verandas](https://www.lasverandasroatan.com/) provides luxury villa and hotel stays nearby. Próspera Weekends include lodging as part of the $450 package.

faqs.question: Can I use Bitcoin in Próspera?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bitcoin is an official unit of account in Próspera, meaning businesses can denominate contracts and pay taxes in BTC. Próspera hosts a Bitcoin center and regular crypto-focused events. The zone is a hub for Bitcoin and broader crypto builders.

faqs.question: How do I learn more or get questions answered before visiting?
faqs.answer: Próspera runs free weekly onboarding calls every Wednesday at 5:00 PM UTC via Zoom. You can join the community on Discord at discord.gg/FKSGnQWxXp or contact support@prospera.hn directly. The [Próspera events calendar](https://luma.com/Prospera-events) lists all upcoming Weekends and special programs.
